newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech rights issue fully subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Czech rights issue fully subscribed.

text.p: Czech insurer Ceska Pojistovna a.s. said on Monday that its share rights issue to raise its basic capital by 1.14 billion crowns to 3.41 billion, has been fully subscribed after the second round.
Pojistovna added in a statement that it had cancelled a possible third round in the issue since all shares on offer were purchased.
"The (second) round was closed a day early since all of the new shares were subscribed," the company said.
Pojistovna added that all of its main shareholders -- banks CSOB, IPB and Komercni Banka, the National Property Fund (NPF), and investment fund PPF -- subscribed to the issue.
In addition to the 1,000 crown nominal value of each share, participants in the round paid a premium of 4,000 crowns per share.

The rate at which shareholders were allowed to buy into the issue was not issued but the first round -- where 968,575 shares of the 1.137 billion on offer were purchased -- was held at a rate of one new share for each two shares current shareholders hold.
